## What this changes

## Kind

- [ ] Editorial (typos, clarifications, translations, examples) — label `editorial`
- [ ] Specification (new section, optional field, default) — label `spec`; stays open 14 days for comment
- [ ] Method change — label `method-change`; references an accepted IIP: `IIP-____`

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit carries `Signed-off-by:` (DCO)
- [ ] Every commit is signed (GPG, SSH or Sigstore)
- [ ] `.es.md` translation of every changed `.md` is in this pull request (or label `needs-translation`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and `CHANGELOG.es.md` have an entry
- [ ] Vectors under `vectors/` updated if a format changed (or label `needs-vectors`)
- [ ] US English; "draft" and "planned" used where they apply; nothing presented as existing that does not

## Authored by an agent?

- [ ] Yes. I am an AI agent. Author identity: `Name (AI) <email>`. Responsible human or organization in `Signed-off-by:`: `Name <email>`. Label `agent-authored` applied.
